title: Amendment A2: relaxed-reference extension
scope: Additive only: the v2.3.1 specification, readings and decision rule stand unchanged. The extension has a separate judge.
arms.A5fR.inputs.0: frozen source encoder features cast float64
arms.A4R.selection: unchanged binary_select; shared inner split; first exact tie; refit all n
arms.A5fRS.inputs.0: frozen source encoder features cast float64
arms.A5fRS.head: same fixed A5fR head
arms.A5fRS.role: descriptive only; excluded from F5, F6 and extension rule
comparator.maximum: maximum of replicate-mean AP, recomputed after aggregation in every bootstrap
comparator.ENS: negative arithmetic mean of five single-point hull distances
comparator.ADDS: intersection-union: max of twelve component upward p-values, then family Holm
comparator.fixed_down_reason: relaxed ORB selected as best label-free score on PILOT before new CONFIRM evaluation; fixed across all designs and bootstraps; sufficient condition for strongest label-free comparator
families.F5.up: IUT over twelve references then Holm; ADDS
families.F5.down: fixed relaxed ORB then Holm; DOES_NOT_EXCEED
families.F6.down: contender maximum minus fixed relaxed ORB then Holm; DOES_NOT_EXCEED
extension_rule.interpretation: relax, then correct, scoped to the specified F6 contender set
designs.P: primary; same five frozen outer folds, draws and inner splits
designs.S_a: secondary; same frozen campaign draws, inner splits and S-a test set
designs.S_b: secondary; same fitted models as S-a; fixed S-b subset
inference.seed_restart: per evaluation design P, S-a, S-b
inference.multiplicity: separate directional Holm within family and design; no global FWER claim
inference.bootstrap: unchanged paired chemical-system cluster weights; M*=mean_r weighted AP_r; no refitting
inference.uncertainty: conditional on fitted models and five frozen draws; percentile bands for maxima descriptive, not calibrated confidence intervals; report draw sample SD
scoring: unchanged sklearn 1.7.2 AP; P pooled out-of-fold AP per draw, then mean; S test AP per draw, then mean; AUROC and per-fold-ceil top-5 percent precision descriptive
missing.trees: NaN into HistGBM, no imputation or dropping
missing.label_free: missing ranks last, ties below every available score
missing.ensemble: strict five-source mean; any missing source makes ENS-R missing
development_choices.fixed_head: The fixed A5f head was selected on reused PILOT and retained without new tuning.
development_choices.fixed_reference: relaxed ORB selected on PILOT as best label-free score
development_choices.F6_set: Development choice: RR/C1 re-references single-point formation energies; no relaxed analogue was developed on PILOT. Seven rather than twelve contenders can ease DNE; relax, then correct is scoped to this set, fixed before relaxed-arm results.
development_choices.report_comparator: Use twelve-score LF_max. The earlier six-score relaxed oracle was equal on PILOT only.
development_choices.source: PILOT only; no claim of independent development validation
interpretive_limits.attribution: F5 does not isolate encoder-feature attribution beyond A4R/ENS-R; no confirmatory contrast against A4R.
interpretive_limits.low_budget: Fixed high-budget head is untuned at 300/1000; this can ease the required DNE leg.
interpretive_limits.informative_leg: PILOT suggests the low leg; F5 at 10000 is the informative leg. Reused PILOT increments may not transfer.
exposure.relaxed_references: Evaluation performance of the relaxed references was previously seen in the earlier study and its follow-up analysis.
exposure.new_arms: A5fR, A4R, ENS-R and A5fRS have never touched CONFIRM labels before this amendment
exposure.question: Post hoc question prompted by earlier evaluation results; the tests were specified before the new relaxed correction arms were evaluated.
exposure.known_reference_values: AP and top-5 percent precision were inspected in P, S-a and S-b; reference values are not new results.
exposure.known_ORB_rank: Relaxed ORB rank was known when fixed: primary AP 0.9349424282920303 versus MatterSim 0.9182220284944321.
exposure.known_predecessor: v2.3.1 CONFIRM A5f/A4/E0 outcomes at every budget and the met rule were known at design time.
exposure.frozen_refit: Two frozen-arm units were refit using 10,941 evaluation-population training labels, without evaluation-label parsing or evaluation.
exposure.checkpoint_identity: Released relaxed-prediction checkpoint identity with frozen encoders is assumed, not proven.
exposure.qualification: Confirmatory, exposure-informed; not independent confirmation on globally unseen CONFIRM. All constants and the rule inherited from predecessor freeze.
C05.criterion: unchanged specified choice: max_seed abs(pooled AP_seed - pooled AP_0) <= 0.005
C05.perturbation_order: all five full feature arrays in frozen source order, then row-major relaxed hull matrix
C05.failure: missing check blocks freeze; any FAIL makes all F5/F6 descriptive, no deletion or resizing; current all-PASS schema cannot authorize failed-C05 evidence: a newly reviewed schema/document and evidence binding is required
machinery: Frozen draws, inner splits, scoring and bootstrap primitives reused; separate extension judge implements amendment rule
